_help: Written by the orchestrator from the user's prompt (PROTOCOL.md step 1), then checked by study.py init. Units N, mm. Remove the requirements the user did not give; keep their words in each 'text'. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

objective._help: Project default: minimize mass. Only if the user asks for it: maximize bending_stiffness or buckling.

bending_stiffness.text: tip stiffness at least 0.05 N/mm when bent downwards
bending_stiffness._help: cantilever (root clamped through a rigid end), tip load load_N along sign*direction; stiffness = |F| / |tip displacement| in that direction. EI given instead: min_N_per_mm = 3 EI / L^3.

buckling.text: must carry 2 N m in opposite-sense bending without buckling
buckling._help: load = bending (axis y; sense opposite = edges in tension, equal = edges in compression; min_value in N mm) or compression (ends clamped|pinned; min_value in N).

coiling.text: coils on a 40 mm radius hub
